Title: General availability: Azure Translator now supports more than 100 languages and dialects

Body.Content:
Azure Translator strives to continuously add support for different languages and dialects to help you streamline your translation workflows and deliver fast, accurate, and affordable language translation. With the recent addition of below 12 new languages, Translator now supports more than 100 languages and dialects.

•Bashkir

•Dhivehi

•Georgian

•Kyrgyz

•Macedonian

•Mongolian (Cyrillic)

•Mongolian (Traditional)

•Tatar

•Tibetan

•Turkmen

•Uyghur

•Uzbek (Latin)

Read the announcement blog.

Register for the upcoming webinar on Translator on 10/21.
